_README: Data for the two trust pages of the Bir × Barot dossier. Everything here must be REAL: real photos from real trips, real words from real people (with their permission), real creators who actually travelled. Empty lists are fine — the pages print a clearly marked slot for each missing item and the PDF filename gets a -DRAFT suffix, so an unfinished dossier can't be sent by accident. Photos go in bir-dossier-assets/.
